hypotheses.persona: Single working adult with a standard 9-to-5 routine
hypotheses.rationale: Morning coffee at 07:26 on Monday, laptop and phone leaving at 08:23 on Wednesday (likely taken to work), keys returning at 17:53 (typical end of workday), and plate at sink at 19:11 (dinner cleanup) strongly support a standard work schedule. The consistent evening meal pattern (fork at 18:45 on Mon/Tue, plate at 19:11 on Wed) reinforces this.

The laptop and phone leaving at 08:23 could also be for a remote worker going to a co-working space or errands, but the keys returning at 17:53 and dinner cleanup at 19:11 are more typical of a fixed workday. The morning coffee at 07:26 is early for a flexible schedule but not impossible.

The laptop and phone leaving at 08:23 and keys returning at 17:53 are inconsistent with a retired person's typical routine. The morning coffee and evening meal times are possible but less likely given the work-related objects.
